items.title: Investors pile into small, mid-caps as earnings momentum improves
items.description: Investors are channeling significant funds into small and mid-cap stocks this fiscal year.  Small-cap funds have seen inflows nearly matching last year's total in just four months.  Mid-cap funds also show strong investor interest, attracting substantial capital inflows.  Large-cap funds, conversely, have experienced considerably lower investment amounts.  This trend reflects improved earnings momentum and increased market liquidity for smaller companies.
